data.text:
🚨The Meat Grinder: How the Rich Use the Brave to Stay Powerful

The sun is barely up, but the trap is already set.

Meet a kid named Sam. He’s 19, smart, and sick of seeing his parents work until their backs break for nothing. He wants to save the world. He wants to be a "Patriot."

But in the Philippines, "Patriotism" is a word that has been stolen.

👉🏽The Puppet Masters

High up in their air-conditioned towers, the Oligarchs and the TRAPOs are watching. They don’t see Sam as a hero. They see him as fuel.

See, these elites need the war to keep going. If there is a "rebel threat" in the mountains, the politician can ask for billions of pesos in "emergency funds."

 Where does that money go? Not to the schools. It goes into their pockets. They play a double game: they use the army to protect their businesses, but they also let the rebels exist because it’s the perfect excuse for why the country is still a mess.

👉🏽The Great Lie

They find kids like Sam and whisper in their ears. They tell them that carrying a gun in the mud is the only way to show "real love" for the country. They take Sam’s fire, his "burning ideology", and they hijack it.

They convince him that the only way to help the poor is to die for a cause that hasn't changed in 50 years. Meanwhile, the leaders of these "activist" groups aren't the ones starving in the rain. They are often living comfortably, using Sam’s life as a bargaining chip to get power.

👉🏽The Cycle of Ghosts

This is the savage truth: The people at the top,on both sides, are friends. They go to the same parties and their kids go to the same fancy schools. They’ve turned the "armed struggle" into a business.

Sam thinks he’s a revolutionary. But to the TRAPO, he’s just a body to be spent. To the Oligarch, he’s a distraction. As long as Sam is busy fighting a war in the jungle, he isn't in the city asking why a few families own the whole country.

The "Patriotism" they sell is a suicide pact. They’ve turned the youth into a meat grinder. They feed in the brave, idealistic kids, and out comes more power and more money for the people who already have everything.

It’s not a revolution. It’s a revolving door. And as long as the youth keep dying for a "dream" that was designed to kill them, the rich will never have to worry about losing their seats.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

24 APRIL 2026

URGENT ROAD CLOSURE ON BEYERS NAUDÉ DRIVE

Location: Beyers Naudé Drive (near West Park Cemetery), Randburg

The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) has been alerted to an incident involving a fallen tree on Beyers Naudé Drive near West Park Cemetery.

A tree has fallen across the roadway, coming to rest on a motor vehicle. There were no passengers in the vehicle. The driver, who was the sole occupant, luckily sustained no injuries.

JMPD officers are currently on the scene. We are awaiting the arrival of Johannesburg City Parks to assist with the removal of the tree and the clearing of the debris.

Due to the size of the tree, the affected section of Beyers Naudé Drive remains closed to traffic. This closure is expected to cause significant delays in the Randburg area.

Motorists are advised to avoid Beyers Naudé Drive in the vicinity of West Park Cemetery. Use alternative routes such as Judith Road, Preller Drive, or Tesselar Terrace to navigate around the obstruction.

Stay alert for emergency and maintenance vehicles operating in the area.

We will provide further updates once the roadway has been cleared and is safe for public use.

END

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) Communications Unit #JoburgRoadSafety #SaferJoburg #JHBTraffic

As the US blockades Iranian ships from sending oil to China, Canada’s military has sent a large force to join Washington’s effort to threaten that country. As Mark Carney calls US ties a “weakness”, Canada’s armed forces are quadrupling down on their US orientation.

Exercise BALIKATAN began Monday. Beijing views the massive US-led 19-day live-fire exercise across the South China Sea and Taiwan Strait as a threat. “Unilateralism and military bullying have already brought profound disasters to the world,” noted China’s foreign ministry spokesperson in response. Guo Jiakun added, “What the Asia-Pacific region most needs is peace and tranquillity. What it least needs is the introduction of external forces to create division and confrontation.”

This is the first time Canada has participated directly in the annual exercise. According to Canada’s ambassador in Manila, this country has dispatched the third largest deployment to the six-country exercise, which includes 10,000 US troops. According to the Canadian forces release, “Led by the United States and the Philippines, Exercise BALIKATAN will involve a broad range of CAF personnel and capabilities, including contributions from the Royal Canadian Navy, Canadian Army, Royal Canadian Air Force, the CAF Cyber Command, and the Canadian Special Operations Forces Command.”

HMCS Charlottetown is part of the exercise while 500 or more Canadian soldiers have travelled 10,000 kilometres to participate in this event.

As part of militaristic 2022 Indo-Pacific Strategy, Canada has deepened ‘defence’ ties with the Philippines. Six months ago, the two countries signed a Status of Visiting Forces Agreement. A year before that they established a Defence Cooperation Memorandum of Understanding and Canada gave the Philippines access to its Dark Vessel Detection System, which employs satellite technology to track ships in the South China Sea.

These efforts are designed to assist the US in its military buildup. The Bongbong Marcos led Philippines has taken a sharp turn back towards the US and against China. According to China Military Online, “Since the Marcos administration resumed defense cooperation with the US in 2022, the US military has been systematically shaping the Philippines into a forward operational hub. This includes the addition of four new military sites, the deployment of the Typhon mid-range missile system, the construction of large, prepositioned ammunition depots, and the frequent conduct of joint military exercises. Taken together, these developments indicate that the US is seeking to turn the Philippines into a forward stronghold for containing its strategic competitors.”

An archipelago of islands just south of Taiwan, the Philippines aid the US strategy to militarily encircle China. In a provocative move, Marcos even said the Philippines would participate in a war over Taiwan.

Exercise BALIKATAN is clearly part of a military buildup targeting China. In a statement on Canada’s role in BALIKATAN the pro-Washington IndoPacific Report explains:
“Canada's shift from observer to active participant in Exercise BALIKATAN 2026 is not merely a training milestone it is a deliberate geopolitical signal. By deploying naval, army, air, cyber, and special operations forces alongside American and Filipino counterparts, Ottawa is operationalizing its Indo-Pacific Strategy in tangible military terms.”

“This matters because the South China Sea remains the central fault line of great-power competition, where Beijing's coercive posture demands credible coalition responses. Canada brings alliance depth, not just capability. Its integration into air and missile defence and maritime strike operations strengthens the layered deterrence architecture that Washington is quietly constructing across the first island chain. Middle powers that show up, train together, and interoperate become harder to dismiss-and harder to isolate. The long-term implication is clear: the Indo-Pacific security order is becoming a coalition project, and Canada has chosen its side of the ledger.”

As Donald Trump threatens to annex Canada and Carney declares US ties a “weakness”, Canada’s military is assisting the US empire in their bid to contain the rise of the world’s most populous nation. Will any politician condemn Canadian participation in Exercise BALIKATAN?
